name: RC-B10-0146/2025/REV1 – After § 22 – Am 56
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the white paper on the future of European defence
part_text: 22a. Urges the Member States to work on a new long-term collective security architecture for Europe inspired by the principles of the Helsinki process and including the concept of mutual security guarantees; notes that a fundamental aspect of such an approach is respect for the sovereignty and territorial integrity of all nations and a commitment to international law;
